correctness.rationale: The lead proof supplies a convex joint admissible support in the Steiner parameter and nm integration variables. Restricting a gamma-concave density to that convex support preserves gamma-concavity in the support-based Borell sense, and the Borell--Brascamp--Lieb marginal theorem gives the exact exponent gamma/(1+nm gamma), including the critical and infinite limits. Rotational invariance gives evenness. Even power-concavity implies monotonicity in absolute parameter. Constant densities on all space or on a centered Euclidean ball yield the 1/(nm)-root concavity corollaries. No finite computation is used.

value.rationale: The result upgrades an endpoint affine-isoperimetric comparison to a full interpolation law with the natural Borell exponent. For Lebesgue measure it is a Brunn--Minkowski-strength root-concavity statement, and the ball-restricted specialization controls the entire centered radial truncation profile simultaneously. This supplies structural information suitable for stability/equality analysis rather than a routine restatement of the endpoint theorem.
